summary: JATT III Acquisition Corp, a blank-check company, filed an 8-K reporting the closing of its IPO and concurrent private placement on August 27, 2026. The company sold 6.9 million ordinary shares at $10 each, including full exercise of the underwriters' over-allotment, for $69 million gross proceeds. It also sold 234,000 private placement shares to JATT Ventures III L.P. for $2.34 million. Net proceeds of $69 million were deposited in trust. An audited balance sheet was included as an exhibit. This is a routine SPAC IPO funding disclosure, not a special-situation event.
